title: 第三十章 他没那么坏
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
沈清萝拿着那片旧纸，在沈伯衡牌位前坐了半夜。

    牌位不说话。

    灯芯烧得很稳。

    她把旧纸翻来覆去看了三遍，最后对着牌位道：“老头子，你是不是早知道？”

    牌位当然不答。

    沈清萝冷笑一声。

    “装死也没用。你本来就死了。”

    谢无咎站在门边，刚好听见这句。

    他沉默片刻。

    “你平时也这么和你爹说话？”

    沈清萝没回头。

    “他欠我解释，我没骂他已经很孝顺了。”

    谢无咎走进来。

    屋里不大，他一进来，就显得更小。沈伯衡的牌位在桌上，旁边放着瓦罐、账本、半盏灯，还有一只被糖糕啃过边的小鱼干盘子。

    怎么看都不像能藏什么大秘密的地方。

    偏偏那片旧纸就在这里掉出来。

    渊中人。

    莫急着赶。

    纸片边缘很旧，像被人摸过很多次，又故意藏了起来。

    沈清萝想了半天，都想不出沈伯衡是什么时候把它塞进手札的。

    也许是在她刚学会写买地券的时候。

    也许是在他病得快起不了身的时候。

    也许更早。

    那个老头子平时看着糊涂，买菜都会多给人两文钱，偏偏在这种事上藏得比谁都深。

    她把纸放到桌上。

    她又想起沈伯衡临死前那几日。

    老头子总说自己没什么事，转头就把旧箱子翻了三遍。那时候她以为他舍不得那些破烂，现在想想，他大概是在确认哪些东西该留下，哪些东西不能让她太早看见。

    越想越气。

    死了还藏话。

    真不愧是把她养大的老头子。

    “你知道这是什么意思吗？”

    谢无咎看着那行字。

    “知道一半。”

    “哪一半？”

    “不该现在说。”

    沈清萝抬头看他。

    “谢无咎！”

    他垂眼。

    她很少这么叫他。

    每次叫，通常都不是开玩笑。

    “你们一个两个的，能不能别总替我决定什么时候该知道？”

    谢无咎沉默了一会儿。

    “知道太早，会死。”

    这话他说得很平。

    可沈清萝听出一点不一样的东西。

    不是吓唬。

    像他自己见过。

    见过有人因为知道太早，被拖进白火里，被写进罪册里，被所有活人当成该死。

    她沉默了一下。

    “我不知道，也没少差点死。”

    这话太实在。

    谢无咎一时没接。

    沈清萝叹了口气，把旧纸收进手札里。
content_en:
Shen Qingluo took the old piece of paper and sat in front of Shen Boheng's memorial tablet for half the night.

The tablets do not speak.

The wick burned steadily.

She turned the old paper over and over three times, and finally said to the tablet: "Old man, did you know this earlier?"

Of course the memorial tablet didn’t answer.

Shen Qingluo sneered.

"There's no point in pretending to be dead. You're already dead."

Xie Wujiu stood by the door and happened to hear this sentence.

He was silent for a moment.

"Do you usually talk to your father like this?"

Shen Qingluo didn't look back.

"He owes me an explanation. I was very filial by not scolding him."

Xie Wujiu walked in.

The room was not big, and as soon as he entered, it seemed even smaller.Shen Boheng's memorial tablet is on the table, next to it are earthen jars, account books, half a lamp, and a small dried fish plate with the edges gnawed by sugar cakes.

It doesn't look like a place where some big secret can be hidden.

It happened that the old piece of paper fell out here.

People in the abyss.

Don't rush.

The edge of the paper was very old, as if it had been touched many times and deliberately hidden.

Shen Qingluo thought about it for a long time, but she couldn't figure out when Shen Boheng put it into the note.

Maybe it was when she first learned how to write land certificates.

Maybe it was when he was too sick to get up.

Maybe earlier.

The old man usually looked confused and would always give someone an extra two pennies when buying groceries, but he hid this kind of thing deeper than anyone else.

She put the paper on the table.

She thought again of the days before Shen Boheng's death.

The old man always said that he had nothing to do, so he turned around and went through the old box three times.At that time, she thought he was reluctant to part with the rags, but now thinking about it, he was probably confirming which things should be kept and which things should not be seen by her too early.

The more I think about it, the angrier I get.

He's still hiding his words even after he's dead.

He really deserves to be the old man who raised her.

"Do you know what this means?"

Xie Wujiu looked at the line of words.

"Half-knowing."

"Which half?"

"Shouldn't say it now."

Shen Qingluo looked up at him.

"Thank you Wu Jiu!"

He lowered his eyes.

She rarely called him that.

Every time it's called, it's usually not a joke.

"You two, can you please stop deciding for me when I should know?"

Xie Wujiu was silent for a while.

"If you know too early, you will die."

He said this very calmly.

But Shen Qingluo heard something different.

Not to scare.

Like he had seen it himself.

I have seen people being dragged into the white fire, written into the book of sins, and treated as damned by all living people because they knew too early.

She was silent for a moment.

"I don't know, I almost died."

This is so true.

Xie Wujiu didn't answer for a while.

Shen Qingluo sighed and put the old paper into the notebook.
